z|cortes_dice_hash_si: Yes, it is yours: {empresa} was receiving “{dato}” disguised as a code (field {campo}).
z|cortes_dice_hash_no: It does not match “{dato}”. Try another email or phone of yours.
z|cortes_det_lleva_fuente: Meaning as documented by {fuentes}; the rest, by the usual name of the field. Values are not kept.
z|cortes_det_sin_leer: And {n} more fields we cannot read.
z|cortes_det_sin_leer_uno: And 1 more field we cannot read.
z|campo_pagina: the address of the page you are on
z|campo_navegador: which browser and system you use
z|campo_cuenta: the company’s account on that site
z|campo_tecnico: technical details of the request itself
z|campo_ip_anonima: the order to shorten your IP
z|campo_consentimiento: your answer to the cookie notice
z|campo_persona_cifrada: data of yours (name, city, date of birth…) turned into code
z|cortes_det_lleva_cuerpo: By the names of the fields in the address and in what was sent, it carried: {que}.
z|cortes_det_cookies: It carried {n} cookies of that company.
z|cortes_det_cookies_uno: It carried 1 cookie of that company.
z|cortes_det_cookies_nota: A cookie that goes back to the same company from another site is how it recognizes you from site to site. Only the name is kept, never the content.
z|cookie_google_analytics: the cookie Google Analytics tells you apart with
z|cookie_meta: the cookie Meta tells you apart with
z|cookie_tiktok: the cookie TikTok tells you apart with
z|cookie_criteo: the cookie Criteo tells you apart with
z|cookie_sesion: your session cookie on that site
z|cookie_consentimiento: your answer to the cookie notice
z|campo_persona: personal details (age, gender, date of birth…)
z|campo_compra: what you buy or look at (products, amounts)
z|cortes_cadena_nota: The chain as the browser sees it: the site you opened had already loaded code from those companies when this request left. The engine does not say which script fired it.
z|cortes_cadena_nota_sin: The request came from the page itself, with no other company’s code loaded before it.
z|gpc_enviada: Told this website not to sell or share your data (GPC signal)
z|auditoria_titulo: The cookie notice, before and after
z|auditoria_antes: Before the notice was answered, the page had already tried to reach {n} tracking or advertising companies ({peticiones} requests)
z|auditoria_antes_uno: Before the notice was answered, the page had already tried to reach 1 tracking or advertising company ({peticiones} requests)
z|auditoria_nota: These are the page’s attempts, blocked by ZERO or not, to companies the open lists class as tracking, advertising or data brokers. Asking for them before your answer does not by itself prove a breach: it depends on what they are used for.
z|auditoria_antes_cero: Before the notice was answered, the page did not try to reach any tracking or advertising company
z|recibo_privacidad_nota: Every request in this list was blocked by GUARDIANA ZERO before it left the browser. “campos” are the names of what it carried, never their values; “lleva” is their meaning, as the company documents it or by the usual name of the field. This receipt does not see other applications on the computer, isolated tabs, what each website’s servers send on their own, or what each company does with what it gets. The signature proves the receipt was not changed after this browser wrote it.
z|recibo_privacidad_guardado: Signed receipt saved to {ruta}. Check it at guardianagroup.com/verificar; this computer’s key fingerprint is {huella}.
z|cortes_servidor_explica: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is in {pais}, on the network of {red}, according to the DB-IP base inside the program (its address is not kept).
z|cortes_servidor_explica_sin_red: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is in {pais}, according to the DB-IP base inside the program (its address is not kept).
z|cortes_servidor_anycast_explica: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is on the network of {red}, which serves the same address from many countries at once: so it has no single country.
z|cortes_sin_pais_nota: When the company is not known, the country is its server’s (“Server in…”), according to the DB-IP base inside the program. “Server spread around the world”: the same address is served from many countries at once. “Headquarters not published” and “Owner not identified” remain only while the server is being looked up or if it could not be found: putting a country there would be inventing it.
z|cortes_recibo_titulo: Saves a file with everything that was blocked, sealed so nobody can change it without it showing
z|cortes_recibo_explica: “Signed receipt (proof)” saves to your Downloads a file with every request ZERO blocked in this period: the time, the page, the company, its country and what it carried. ZERO seals it with a key that only exists in this browser, like the wax seal on an envelope: if anyone changes a single letter, the seal no longer fits. It works as proof for a lawyer, an authority or a journalist, and anyone can check it at guardianagroup.com/verificar without installing anything.
z|sec_frase_v1: Messages, files and calls between computers, encrypted end to end: nobody in between can read them, not even GUARDIANA.
z|sec_c_recibir_texto: This computer waits for the other one to call. GUARDIANA opens a port on your router by itself and gives you a code so they can call you.
z|sec_c_llamar_texto: Paste the code the other person gave you (or their address:port if you are on the same network). It is not kept.
z|sec_s_texto: You see three numbers, and so does the other person. Read them out loud, by phone or in person. If they match, the identity is verified and remembered for next time. If not, someone may be in the middle: click “They don’t match”.
z|sec_p_ocupado_que: Close the other call or the program using it (Zoom, Teams, WhatsApp…) and try again.
z|sec_p_ocupado_camara: Another program is using the camera: the call goes on with voice
z|sec_p_ocupado_microfono: Another program is using the microphone
z|sec_p_no_hay_que: Plug in a headset with a microphone or a camera and press «Done, try again».
z|sec_p_no_hay_camara: No camera is connected: the call goes on with voice
z|sec_p_bloqueado_que: Press the button, turn on «Let desktop apps access» and come back here.
z|sec_p_bloqueado_camara: Windows is not letting apps use the camera: the call goes on with voice
z|sec_p_bloqueado_microfono: Windows is not letting apps use the microphone
z|sec_c_cortada: The conversation was cut. The messages stay here; to talk again, invite again or type their code.
z|sec_l_sin_camara: No camera: the call goes on with voice only.
z|sec_l_sin_medios: The microphone and camera could not start for the call. Hang up and try again.
z|sec_tarjeta_mala: The other computer’s identity is not properly signed, so it does not connect.
z|sec_sas_no: The numbers did not match: the conversation was closed without verifying.
z|sec_sas_fallo: The verification failed and the conversation was closed.
z|sec_err_archivo: The file could not be saved.
z|sec_archivo_mal: The file arrived damaged or incomplete and was discarded.
z|sec_en_pausa: The conversation is paused; nothing is sent.
z|sec_permiso_navegador: To use the microphone and the camera, allow them in the browser: click the padlock or the icon next to the address (127.0.0.1) and choose “Allow”.
z|sec_puente_otra: Communications is open in another tab. Use that one, or reload this one to bring it here.
z|sec_puente_cerrado: Communications closed on this computer. Open it again from the applications menu (“GUARDIANA Communications”) or type guardiana comunicaciones.
z|sec_l_sin_permiso: Without permission to use the microphone or camera, the call cannot start.
z|sec_l_no_reproduce: This browser cannot play the call.
z|sec_r_pdf_nota: This PDF is a copy to read or print. The proof that can be checked is the JSON file, which carries this same signature.
z|sec_r_pdf_firmado: Signed by this computer (public key and Ed25519 signature):
z|sec_r_nota: Signed with this computer’s key. No message contents, no file names, no addresses.
z|sec_c_codigo_texto: Give this code to the other person (by phone, by message). With it they can call you from anywhere. It expires when you close.
z|sec_c_abriendo: Opening a port on your router…
z|sec_c_sin_puerta: Your router would not open a port ({e}). From your own network, the other person can connect to port {p}. From outside, better the other way round: let the other person invite you and type their code under “I have an invitation”.
z|sec_c_rele_texto: Your router would not open a port, so GUARDIANA uses its relay server: it only joins the two connections and passes data that is already encrypted; it can read nothing and keeps no addresses. Give this code to the other person. It expires when you close.
z|sec_c_rele_listo: No port open on the router. Waiting at the relay server.
z|sec_c_rele_buscando: No port open on the router. Connecting to the relay server…
z|sec_e_buscando: Looking for the other person through the relay server…
z|sec_rele_fallo: The relay server could not be used: {e}
z|sec_paso_1: One of you clicks “New conversation” and sends the link or the code (GR-…) by WhatsApp or email.
z|sec_paso_2: The other person opens it on their phone, or on their PC types it under “I have an invitation” and clicks “Join”.
z|sec_paso_3: You compare the three numbers out loud with the other person. If they match, the conversation starts.
z|sec_mv_texto: Open your phone’s or tablet’s camera and point it at the code. A guardianagroup.com page opens that talks to this computer, encrypted end to end, with nothing to install: directly on your own Wi-Fi and, when that is not possible, through GUARDIANA’s relay server, which cannot read anything. Works on iPhone, iPad and Android. Two-person conversations only.
z|sec_mv_e_espera: Waiting for you to scan the code
z|sec_mv_e_fuera: Phone accepted · not connected right now
z|sec_mv_e_habla: The conversation is on your phone
z|sec_mv_ok_texto: A phone just connected with this code. Is it yours?
z|sec_mv_e_pasando: Moving the call to the phone… this computer keeps it until the phone has sound.
z|sec_mv_no_paso: Could not move it — scan again
z|sec_mv_habla: The call and the chat continue on your phone. Meanwhile this computer uses neither the microphone nor the camera.
z|sec_mv_fuera_abriendo: Opening a port on the router so the phone can also join on mobile data…
z|sec_mv_fuera_si: Port open: the phone can carry the conversation outside, on mobile data.
z|sec_mv_fuera_no: The router did not open the port ({e}): away from your Wi-Fi, the phone joins through the relay server, just as encrypted.
z|sec_mv_soltado: The phone disconnected. If it connects again, everything carries on where it was.
z|sec_mv_error: The hand-off to the phone could not be prepared: {e}
z|sec_mv_solo_dos: Moving to the phone only works in two-person conversations.
z|sec_c_invitar_texto: Press “Invite someone” and GUARDIANA gives you a code. Send it to the other person: when they type it into their GUARDIANA, the conversation opens here.
z|sec_c_tengo_texto: Did someone send you a code (GS-… or GR-…)? Type it here and press “Join”.

z|sec_c_via_rele: Connection through GUARDIANA’s relay server: it only passes data that is already encrypted and cannot read it.
z|sec_c_tu_nombre: Your name (as the others will see you)
z|sec_c_mas: To invite more people, the same code:
z|sec_s_nuevo: {n} is joining. Compare the numbers with them.
z|sec_archivo_cortado: The connection dropped in the middle of the file and it could not be resumed; send it again.
